title: saas-skills project configuration
description: Per-project knobs for the saas-skills plugin hooks. Lives at .claude/saas-skills.json in the project that installed the plugin; every section is optional and an absent section leaves its hook inert.

toolkitVersion.description: Version of the saas-skills plugin that last scaffolded this project's files. Read by /saas-skills:upgrade to know which template changes still have to be applied.

guard.description: Deterministic rule enforced by the PreToolUse hook on Write|Edit, plus the advisory context it injects.

pathScope.description: Only files whose path contains this substring are checked.

testFilePatterns.description: Globs marking a file as a test. Test files are exempt from every deterministic rule.

forbiddenPatterns.description: Runtime APIs that must never reach shipped code. A match blocks the write.

pattern.description: POSIX extended regular expression matched against the file content.

message.description: Why it is blocked and what to do instead. Shown to the agent.

advisoryContext.description: Text injected into the agent's context on every allowed write. Use it for the judgment rules that must never hard-block, such as the TDD reminder and domain boundaries.

docsSync.description: PostToolUse reminder keeping docs/**/INDEX.md a projection of the files on disk.

watchPaths.description: Path fragments that trigger the reminder.

sessionStart.description: Environment bootstrap run at the start of a session.

remoteOnly.description: When true, only runs on Claude Code web sessions and leaves local machines untouched.

commands.description: Shell commands run in order from the project root.

delivery.description: Read by /spec, /implement and the review agents. Absent when the project does not use them; every key below is optional and an absent key means the behavior it drives does not run.

linear.description: Where planning lives. The delivery commands refuse to create issues without a team.

teamKey.description: The team's slug in Linear — the prefix its issues carry, e.g. ENG, LOVI, ACME. Asked during /saas-skills:setup, never guessed from the repository name.

projectId.description: Optional Linear project the work belongs to.

riskLabels.description: Issue labels that make an epic require the operator's own approval on top of the approver agent, e.g. risk:payments. An empty list means the approver is the only gate.

riskDomains.description: Areas the reviewers weigh extra. This is what makes bug-reviewer and spec-verifier sharp for this product instead of generic.

name.description: The area, e.g. payments, uploads, tenancy.

whatBreaks.description: What tends to go wrong there, in one sentence the reviewer can check against a diff.

commands.description: The project's own commands, exactly as CI runs them. Agents never invent one; a missing key means that step is skipped and reported.

deploy.description: Deploy verification for the ship agent. OMIT THIS BLOCK ENTIRELY when there is no deploy check — ship then finishes at 'merged, issue closed' instead of claiming a deployment it never observed.

healthUrl.description: Polled after a merge into the default branch.

statusCommand.description: Shell command reporting the deployment state; must exit non-zero while it is not healthy.

requiredEnvVars.description: Variable NAMES checked as present in the target environment. Values are never read or printed.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the deployment before reporting a failure.
